paper.title: GeoPT: Scaling Physics Simulation via Lifted Geometric Pre-Training
paper.method_summary: Dynamics-lifted geometric self-supervision augments unlabeled geometry with synthetic evolution cues; pretraining on more than one million samples improves downstream multi-physics surrogate learning.
paper.limitations: Requires downstream fine-tuning and normalization/alignment of geometry; no proven zero-shot generality across unseen PDEs or exact discrete conservation.
paper.notes: Pre-existing arXiv 2602.20399 preprint is upgraded using official ICML 2026 PMLR 306 proceedings, published online 2026-09-29.

paper.title: Imposing Boundary Conditions on Neural Operators via Learned Function Extensions
paper.method_summary: Learned boundary-to-domain pseudo-extension maps heterogeneous boundary data into a field consumable by standard domain-to-domain neural operators. Evaluation covers 18 datasets.
paper.limitations: Boundary lifting is learned, not an exact BC-enforcement theorem for every operator; benchmarks do not establish universal cross-PDE zero-shot performance.
paper.notes: New registered formal identity; official ICML 2026 proceedings match arXiv 2602.04923 and authors.

paper.title: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation
paper.method_summary: A learned contractive fixed-point correction module refines pretrained neural-operator outputs, with a frequency-progressive loss aimed at reducing spectral bias.
paper.limitations: Convergence guarantee requires contraction assumptions; iterative corrections add cost and are not equivalent to a one-pass non-autoregressive trajectory solver.
paper.notes: New registered formal identity; official PMLR ICML 2026 proceedings matched to arXiv 2605.24041.

paper.title: Do Neural Operators Forget Geometry? The Forgetting Hypothesis in Deep Operator Learning
paper.method_summary: Layer-wise geometry probing identifies progressive loss of boundary/geometry signals in neural operators; geometry memory injection at intermediate layers counters the degradation.
paper.limitations: A diagnostic and conditioning remedy, not a standalone general PDE solver; exact boundary enforcement and transfer to arbitrary 3D meshes are not established.
paper.notes: Pre-existing arXiv 2605.05862 preprint is upgraded using official PMLR ICML 2026 proceedings.
